description: Create a new post (a thread with a starter message) in a forum channel. Requires the Send Messages and Create Public Threads permissions. Use discord_reply_to_forum to add follow-up messages. Returns the new post's name and thread ID.

applied_tags.description: Optional tag IDs to apply. Get valid IDs from discord_get_forum_tags.

content.description: Body of the post's starter message (max 2000 characters).

forum_channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the forum channel to post in.

title.description: Title of the post, used as the thread name (max 100 characters).

name: discord_create_forum_post
